rationale: No. Read in full: EO 9446 prescribed five paragraphs of Veterans' Administration travel-expense regulations. Paragraph 5 of EO 9975 (signed 1948-07-07; held Federal Register text, 13 FR 3805) states "This order supersedes Executive Order No. 9446 of June 8, 1944" and re-prescribes the subject; it has no later effective-date clause. Both observations (the 9 FR 6293 catalog record and the 1989 OFR 'Superseded by EO 9975' row) were reviewed and agree. The supersession is of the whole order, so no partial scope remains; the successor order carries the subject forward (savings).
